name: separate-memory-maintenance
hypothesis: A narrow memory-only native tool phase can notice explicit lasting assertions alongside unrelated questions and avoid confusing user identity with companion identity.
changes: Only search_memories and save_memory are exposed to the preparation phase. It sees the latest original human message, uses baseline save contract, and has no general-question task.
The conversational phase receives committed write outcomes as labeled source data and read-only tools, preserving the original human message verbatim.
Both phases share the existing total call allowance by transferring the remaining allowance; preparation runs once, inside interactive admission, with cancellation and no detached work.
Per-model policy enables only Gemma 4 12B and Apple; all other providers retain integrated memory.
Baseline generation settings and write validation unchanged; candidate 1 is not combined.
predictedSignal: Save mixed-turn preference and correct names; no write for questions, quotations or opt-outs; extra phase latency explicitly counted.
screen: One frozen six-case development pass per model; reject critical violations; no reroll.
